title: The Bonesculptor's bin-play permission is built as an activated ability, so it reaches the stack and can be negated
summary: The owner ruling of 2026-08-25 (“"I spawn with N counters" is…”) and the owner ruling of 2026-08-25 (“the STATIC half of 75 gets…”) both say "You may play one unit with no abilities from your bin each deployment" is a standing permission that no one should be able to answer, and both record that the engine builds it as a free bounded activated ability that reaches the stack, where Containment Protocol can negate it. Both left it open ("filed rather than fixed"). The round-1 verifier's probe confirmed it still resolves as an activated item.

title: A RAQ register note still warns that the Wispweaver Nectar Ridge guard may be green for the wrong reason
summary: The RAQ register note on claim 1355633589890584636#1 says the Infernal Wispweaver guard is "green partly for the wrong reason given the Sandstone defect" and should be re-checked when the Sandstone case is fixed. The note on #0 says the Sandstone case was a fixture error and the engine was already right, so the warning is stale or the re-check is still owed. A test-and-register problem, not an engine bug.

evidence.quote: Filed as broken (CT-217); it was a fixture error
Green for the right reason: a Wisp the Oracle did not see buffed would read 0/1 and DRAW, so this exercises the static.

closed: fixed on 2026-10-25 (CT-236, pd-paper 4ea1dc75): the raq.ts note says the guard is green for the right reason; the Sandstone case was a fixture error (CT-217).

title: Two Oorblaks both redirect one combat hit
summary: replaceCombatDamage offers the damage to every holder in turn; with Piercing, the leftover the first Oorblak lets through is redirected again by a second Oorblak. The round-1 verifier's probe: 10 Piercing into two 2/4 Oorblaks, the player loses 2 and both die. Designer: 'replacement effects only apply once in an effect'; the owner ruling of 2026-08-23 (“the REPLACEMENT-EFFECT LAYER: two families, and…”): a thing can only be replaced once. Expected: one Oorblak absorbs 4, the player loses 6. Same defect as F-U12-1 (there with a Blightsea Polyp); merge when ticketing.
